name: auto_evict_lru
description: Evict least-recently-used Ollama models when total VRAM exceeds `threshold_mb`. Models are sorted by expiry time (soonest first = LRU) and evicted until VRAM drops below the threshold. Use `dry_run=true` to preview.

parameters.name: threshold_mb
parameters.description: VRAM ceiling in MiB (defaults to VRAM_EVICT_THRESHOLD_MB env or 20000)

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Report what would be evicted without evicting
